premise: Hedgehog tries to nap but Squirrel's nibbling is too loud, so he curls into a ball, and Squirrel tiptoes away with her nut.
inspiration: The Princess and the Pea (Andersen), turned from a pea to a noise: the smallest thing keeps you awake, and a friend's kindness fixes it.
lesson: Noticing what a friend needs, and giving it quietly.
learning: A hedgehog rolls up into a round prickly ball

en-US.title: Hedgehog Wants a Nap
en-US.text: One lazy afternoon, {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog came scurrying into the meadow for a nap. [softly] He {hedgehog:live hold} tucked in his nose and curled up into a round, prickly ball. {sfx:nibble} Crunch, crunch, crunch! Along bounded {squirrel:enter} Squirrel, {squirrel:face happy} nibbling her hazelnut right next to him. Crunch, crunch. Hedgehog {hedgehog:live resume} uncurled, peeked out, and sniffed. Who's that? {hedgehog:face sad} [sighs] He couldn't sleep a wink. {mouse:enter} Mouse came scampering over the grass. He {mouse:live} sniffed the air, rose up on tiptoe to look… then dropped down and washed his whiskers. [whispers] Squirrel, he said, Hedgehog is trying to nap. {squirrel:live} Squirrel took one last nibble, looked left and right, hid her hazelnut behind her back… and hugged it. {squirrel:face surprised} Oops, she whispered, {squirrel:tint #FFB3C6} blushing. I'll save it for later. So Squirrel and Mouse tiptoed away, {mouse:fade-out} tip, tip, tip. {hedgehog:face sleeping} [softly] And Hedgehog {hedgehog:live hold} curled up into his ball again, {hedgehog:glow} warm and round, and slept all afternoon.

es-ES.title: Erizo quiere echar la siesta
es-ES.text: Una tarde tranquila, {hedgehog:enter} Erizo llegó correteando al prado para echar la siesta. [softly] {hedgehog:live hold} Escondió la nariz y se hizo una bola redonda y pinchuda. {sfx:nibble} ¡Cronch, cronch, cronch! Llegó dando brincos {squirrel:enter} Ardilla, {squirrel:face happy} mordisqueando su avellana justo a su lado. Cronch, cronch. Erizo {hedgehog:live resume} se desenrolló, asomó la nariz y olfateó. ¿Quién es? {hedgehog:face sad} [sighs] No conseguía dormir. {mouse:enter} Ratón llegó correteando por la hierba. {mouse:live} Olfateó el aire, se puso de puntillas para mirar… luego bajó y se lavó los bigotes. [whispers] Ardilla, dijo, Erizo quiere dormir la siesta. {squirrel:live} Ardilla dio un último mordisquito, miró a un lado y a otro, escondió la avellana detrás de la espalda… y la abrazó. {squirrel:face surprised} Uy, susurró, {squirrel:tint #FFB3C6} colorada. La guardo para luego. Así que Ardilla y Ratón se fueron de puntillas, {mouse:fade-out} tip, tip, tip. {hedgehog:face sleeping} [softly] Y Erizo {hedgehog:live hold} se hizo otra vez una bola, {hedgehog:glow} calentita y redonda, y durmió toda la tarde.

nibble.prompt: a squirrel crunching a hazelnut with tiny quick nibbles
